name: everywhere
description: Connect Claude to the Workday Agent Gateway over HTTP MCP. Tools are discovered from your gateway at runtime; this plugin ships no skills.

gateway_url.title: Agent Gateway MCP URL
gateway_url.description: Full MCP endpoint for your tenant, e.g. https://<region>.agent.workday.com/<your-tenant>/mcp

wd_tenant.title: Workday tenant
wd_tenant.description: Sent as the WD-Tenant header, e.g. your-tenant-here.

wd_agent_tenant_alias.title: Workday agent tenant alias
wd_agent_tenant_alias.description: Sent as the WD-Agent-Tenant-Alias header, e.g. your-alias-here.
